literal: Non-lying like fame there is not; without weariness all virtues it will give.
translation: There is no fame like that of never lying. Without any further effort, it will yield every other virtue.
modern: பொய் சொல்லாமல் இருப்பதைப் போன்ற சிறந்த புகழ் வேறு இல்லை. அது ஒருவருக்கு எந்தச் சிரமமும் இல்லாமல் மற்ற எல்லா அறங்களையும் கொடுக்கும்.
explanation: This couplet highlights the supreme value of truthfulness among all virtues. The word 'பொய்யாமை' means the practice of never telling a lie, which is described as the greatest source of fame. The term 'எய்யாமை' means without weariness or effort. The poet explains that simply maintaining truthfulness will automatically and effortlessly bring the benefits of all other moral virtues to a person.
